findings.location: architecture.md D17 Create (line 110), S5 public oracle (line 4531), S4 IUnitSettings.CreateTeam(Action<Team>) (line 4331) versus S3 IUnitLifecycle.CreateTeam(Team) (line 3477)
findings.obligation: P4/P6: creating a Team creates its unit and its capacity row in one commit; one owner per rule (code-craftsmanship: one owner per fact).
findings.remediation: Blocking for the S5 oracle. (1) The Team entity that StageForNewTeam needs is built inside IUnitSettings.CreateTeam(Action<Team>), so the controller and the oracle have no Team to pass before the call; say who builds it (for example the controller builds the Team, stages it, then calls one create method taking the Team) or give CreateTeam a seam to stage inside the delegate (Action<Team> is synchronous while StageForNewTeam returns Task). (2) Two create ports exist: IUnitLifecycle.CreateTeam(Team) (S3, publishes UnitCreated) and IUnitSettings.CreateTeam(Action<Team>) (S4/S5); name the single one the controller calls after S4 and who publishes UnitCreated, or drop one, so UnitCreated is published once and the S5 oracle drives the same port as S3's. Counterexample: write the S5 create-then-read oracle line 'StageForNewTeam, then IUnitSettings.CreateTeam': no Team instance is available at the StageForNewTeam call.

observations.text: Reopened to drop the superseded revision-5 finding (Stage without a create path): revision 6 adds StageForNewTeam(Team, LeafCapacityValues) at architecture.md:4988, so that finding is resolved; the remaining finding is the new create-port defect (R8).

diagnostic: Rejected on one blocking finding (owner design): the revised create path cannot be written as the S5 oracle describes, because IUnitSettings.CreateTeam(Action<Team>) builds the Team after the controller must already have passed it to StageForNewTeam, and S3 declares a second create port IUnitLifecycle.CreateTeam. Team in Forecasting Contracts is within the module rules; the update path and refused-save claim are sound. Test-writing last lines: SKILL.md 'End of SKILL.md'; backend.md 'End of backend.md'.
